turns.character_response:
The music soared as Cinderella and the prince twirled together, both smiling brighter than the moonlight. But suddenly—bong, bong!—the clock struck midnight! She dashed away, her heart racing, and on the steps—oops!—her glass slipper fell off.

The prince searched high and low across the kingdom, trying that tiny slipper on every foot he could find. And when it fit Cinderella perfectly, her true self shone through—kind, brave, and full of hope.

So in the end, love and goodness found their way. And that’s the magic of kindness: it can turn anyone’s story into a happily ever after. And now, my friend, that’s our warm, snowy ending!
